(: User
   (* (: id int)
      (: name str)))

(User 7 "Ada")

(: UserContract
   (* (: id int)
      (: name str)))

(: HistoryOptions
   (* (: mode "copy")
      (: contract UserContract)))

(: history_request
   (* (: result type)))

(<- (history_request ?Result)
    (HistoryV1 User HistoryOptions ?Result))

(: UserPatch (Partial User))
(: MaybePatch (Option (Partial User)))

(: PrimaryKeyOptions
   (* (: unique "yes")))

(: Ledger
   (* (: (Key "account" PrimaryKeyOptions) int)
      (: payload str)
      (: (Key "revision" PrimaryKeyOptions) int)))

(: selected_request
   (* (: result type)))

(<- (selected_request ?Result)
    (Partial User ?Partial)
    (edge_snapshot ?Partial ?FirstName ?FirstType 0)
    (edge_snapshot ?Partial ?SecondName ?SecondType 1)
    (Pick ?Partial (tuple ?FirstName ?SecondName) ?Result))

(: excluded_request
   (* (: result type)))

(<- (excluded_request ?Result)
    (selected_request ?Selected)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selected ?RemovedName ?RemovedType 0)
    (Exclude ?Selected (tuple ?RemovedName) ?Result))

(: unchanged_request
   (* (: result type)))

(<- (unchanged_request ?Result)
    (selected_request ?Selected)
    (Exclude ?Selected (tuple) ?Result))
